name: t3-sidebar
description: The T3 Code web app in a Cursor/VS Code sidebar, with working copy and paste.

t3Sidebar.serverUrl.description: T3 Code server URL. Leave empty to use the running T3 Code desktop app's server (from ~/.t3/userdata/server-runtime.json), falling back to http://127.0.0.1:3773.

t3Sidebar.proxyPort.description: First local port to try for the paste-enabling relay. The next 9 ports are tried if it is busy (for example, a second Cursor window).

t3Sidebar.openOnStartup.description: Reveal the T3 Code view when the window opens.

t3Sidebar.selectOnStartup.description: When openOnStartup is off and the sidebar holding T3 Code is already open at startup, switch it to T3 Code (Cursor switches it to its own agent view when quitting). A closed sidebar is left closed.

t3Sidebar.autoPair.description: When not signed in, issue a short-lived pairing token with the t3 CLI and sign in automatically.

t3Sidebar.cliPath.description: Path to the t3 CLI. Leave empty to search ~/.t3/bin/t3 (t3.cmd on Windows), /opt/homebrew/bin/t3, /usr/local/bin/t3 and PATH.

t3Sidebar.editorShortcuts.markdownDescription: Shortcuts that go to Cursor instead of T3 Code while T3 is focused, mapped to the Cursor command each one runs. Write shortcuts as modifiers in the order `cmd`, `ctrl`, `alt`, `shift`, then the key, joined with `+` (for example `cmd+shift+p`). Takes effect after **T3 Sidebar: Reload**.
